summary_en: SIGMAXYZ Holdings will cancel 977,240 common shares on December 21, 2026, representing 1.1% of issued shares before cancellation, reducing total issued shares to 85 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 6, 2026, SIGMAXYZ Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel 977,240 common shares effective December 21, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 1.1% of issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be reduced to 85 million shares. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 4,504,427 treasury shares against total issued shares of 85,977,240.
